loader_analysis.identity: Managed AMSI-bypass loader for an obfuscated Phemedrone information stealer
loader_analysis.debug_gate: CIL 0x0091-0x00b9 calls CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent through a delegate, tests Debugger.IsAttached and the native boolean, calls IsDebuggerPresent through another delegate, and exits with code 1 if any test reports a debugger.
loader_analysis.amsi: Loads amsi.dll; Base64/repeating-key XOR resolves AmsiScanBuffer. VirtualProtect sets PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (64), Marshal.Copy installs E_INVALIDARG return bytes (B8 57 00 07 80 C3 on 64-bit; B8 57 00 07 80 C2 18 00 on 32-bit), and restores protection.
loader_analysis.payload: A static constructor initializes a 73,808-character Base64 string. The repeating-key XOR helper at RVA 0x2258 decodes it; the GZip helper at RVA 0x2290 decompresses it; Assembly.Load loads the bytes, gets EntryPoint, and invokes it with split arguments or no arguments.
loader_analysis.decoded_stage_flow: Entry MethodDef 23 calls its environment gate, instantiates and groups collectors (generic method 1, Araxazibapoky; GroupBy/Select/ToList), runs their collection threads, writes records to an in-memory ZIP, and calls configured sender Send with MemoryStream.ToArray. Wallet collector reads wallet.dat and cold-wallet stores into Wallets/ records; Chromium and Gecko collectors decrypt browser credentials; screenshot collector copies the desktop into a PNG record. Sender MethodDef 177 formats https://api.telegram.org/bot{0}/sendDocument and passes the same archive bytes to multipart HTTP POST helper MethodDef 172, which writes the request body and obtains a response. VM FailFast and analysis-process killing are enabled; the CIS-locale gate is disabled in this build.
loader_analysis.decoded_strings: Payload helper MethodDef 426 XORs Base64-decoded bytes with a repeating string initialized by MethodDef 428; decoded IL retained in scratch. No sample code was executed.
loader_analysis.verdict_basis: Unconditional AMSI sabotage followed by concealed execution of a credential, wallet, token and screenshot collector with configured Telegram export. There is no legitimate editor or diagnostic purpose supported by these paths.
loader_analysis.missing_context: Original batch wrapper, invocation arguments, victim environment and network success are unavailable; none is required to establish the static hostile chain.
loader_analysis.coverage_gap: The outer scan retains two hostile traits and gains one suspicious debugger-gate trait. The 3-5 hostile goal is not reached on the outer file. The extracted stage already has six hostile detections across collection, credential access, exfiltration and family identity. Atomscan does not automatically perform this arbitrary-key XOR plus GZip assembly extraction, so the outer file does not inherit the stage detections. A generic static matcher cannot assert its concealed browser/wallet/Telegram data paths from opaque encrypted bytes. The extraction and independent scan verify the gap; raising debugger detection to hostile would misstate that dual-use technique.

pxt_analysis.identity: Microsoft Programming Experience Toolkit / MakeCode source archives, versions 1.5.5 and 1.1.1
pxt_analysis.provenance: Forager fetched each version from https://proxy.golang.org/github.com/microsoft/pxt/@v/v<VERSION>.zip with its requested SHA-256. Both archives match exactly; originals and .forage.json records remain in scratch.
pxt_analysis.purpose_and_flow: The package manifests identify pxt-core and its version. CLI code builds compilers, editor assets and firmware and serves a local project workspace. pxtwinrt/deploy.ts filters removable device names using target compile.deployDrives, writes compiler-produced HEX/UF2 firmware, and opens user export files through Windows.System.Launcher.launchFileAsync. Serial code watches configured serial devices and passes received data to the editor. WinRT workspace code reads and writes local project storage. The UWP manifest starts the MakeCode page and grants all WinRT APIs to selected MakeCode origins and a localhost development URL.
pxt_analysis.suspicious_findings_review: Every suspicious finding is the accurate HTTP/HTTPS content rule with WindowsRuntimeAccess=all. Version 1.5.5 has four matching member manifests, version 1.1.1 one; each outer archive inherits one unique trait. The debug UWP build copies are genuine source archive contents. These security-boundary grants remain suspicious despite a benign package verdict.
pxt_analysis.dependencies: No hostile or suspicious finding in these scans originates in a fetched dependency. GitHub frontend, Bing map, npm and documentation dependencies retain their accurate neutral findings; no dependent-package exception was added.
pxt_analysis.verdict_basis: Byte-identical upstream archives plus traced, purpose-consistent editor, compiler, project-storage and firmware-deployment paths; no concrete hostile operation identified. Broad permissions alone are not malicious intent.
pxt_analysis.missing_context: No deployment context is supplied. A source archive does not establish what content a remote hosted page would serve at another time. Analyzer flow budgets limit some large files; source tracing and exact provenance corroborate this judgment.
pxt_analysis.classifier_disagreement: Both remain hostile in atomscan despite the benign judgments. Accurate suspicious authority grants were preserved; no score-oriented suppression or severity reduction was made.
